name: Echo
pitch: A podcast player you can set up once and leave in your pocket.
lead: A podcast player you can set up once and leave in your pocket. New episodes line up on their own, voices come through clearly, and it works with no account.
features: Star a show and its new episodes join your Queue on their own. Press play, put your phone away, and Echo works through it in order.

Set skip back and skip forward separately, from 10 seconds up to a minute and a half. Give each show its own: long jumps past the ads on one, short hops back on another. A show can keep its own speed and download rules too.
Voice Boost evens out the volume, so a quiet guest sounds as close as a loud host. Trim Silence shortens long pauses, so episodes finish sooner without anyone sounding sped up.
Save a moment in one tap and jump back to it later. The sleep timer stops after 30 or 60 minutes, at the end of the episode, or at a time you pick.
Search by name, browse categories or the top charts, or paste a private feed link from a paid service. Search Episodes finds an episode on any topic without following the whole show.
Lock screen, home screen and car
Control Echo from the lock screen, earbuds or Android Auto, and add home-screen widgets for your Queue, a playlist, new episodes or your listening stats.
data: Your library, Queue and listening history are stored on your phone, and Echo works with no account.
If you choose the optional backup, it goes to a folder in your own Google Drive. The optional Sync keeps a copy on Echo's server so your devices all match.
plans: Every feature on your phone, with no ads and no account.
A backup of your library, Queue and history to your own Google Drive every day, and whenever you ask.
Your library kept in your account as you listen, so every device matches and a new phone picks up right where you left off. Includes the daily backup.
